description: This PHP source file defines the MaintenanceService class, which provides functionalities for retrieving purgeable entities based on configuration, managing access strategies to employee data, handling database transactions for GDPR compliance, and interfacing with a MaintenanceDao for data extraction. It is part of the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin ecosystem.

classes.name: MaintenanceService
classes.description: Provides services for managing maintenance operations including GDPR compliance, entity data purge, and access control strategies.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Reads a YAML configuration file to retrieve a list of entities that can be purged.

methods.name: getAccessStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns an access strategy object for a specific entity class based on the provided strategy name and info array.

methods.name: accessEmployeeData
methods.description: Retrieves data related to an employee for GDPR purposes, handling database transactions and access strategies.

methods.name: getMaintenanceDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MaintenanceDao object.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Delegates data extraction for a given employee number and table to MaintenanceDao.
